name: projection_o_transpose_v1
hypothesis: For O projection at M16 and M32, compute row-major W @ X.T and return the transposed output view. This changes cuBLAS operand orientation without repacking BF16 weights or adding a transpose kernel. Preserve the specialized M8 route and every other dispatch.
decision_reason: Official H200 checker passed correctness but scored 1.5152x (95% CI 1.4925–1.5379), below the current 1.5177x public result. The PyTorch row-major W@X.T cuBLAS dispatch regressed O decode-16/32 to 1.012x/1.019x; the external reported gain came from a tuned custom layout/kernel, not this generic matmul. Keep current specialized kernels.
